check-acceptance-criteria.summary: Checks the change against the known acceptance criteria and product decisions

check-correctness.summary: Traces concrete inputs through the new logic to find wrong results

check-security.summary: Checks trust boundaries, secrets, injection, and tenant isolation

check-rules.summary: Checks the change against the repository's own rules and agent instructions

check-docs.summary: Checks that the docs still match the code after this change

check-supportability.summary: Checks that failures surface, can be traced, and can be recovered

check-performance.summary: Flags only bottlenecks too large for the change's real workload

check-architecture.summary: Judges whether the design is as simple as it could be, and proposes a simpler one
